cutoffs.measure: native ETH + WETH/USDC/USDT/DAI/WBTC/stETH/wstETH/USDe on a public RPC

discovery.method: The held-funds candidate list was measured again on a public RPC because the earlier Actions run did not store under-$5,000 balances. Contracts with code and at least $0.01 under $5,000 were kept. That set was under 500, so deferred rows from the earlier under-$5k pools were measured again, then Ethereum addresses from DefiLlama's protocol list were measured the same way. The top 500 by balance are this file.
discovery.excluded: queue 1, queue 2, the first small-value queue, the signal-rerun seen skip list, token and router addresses, and accounts with no code. The production scan table was not readable here; a later batch still skips stored rows marked done.
